description: WHEN something must change in Démarchage (add or qualify a lead, contact ONE prospect, send ONE prepared reply, publish ONE post, pause ads, edit the agenda…): POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE on a /api/admin/demarchage/… route. Bulk sends (envoyer, relances/lancer, orchestrer, file/rejouer, leads/rattraper, rebonds/traiter) are refused. Admin key only.
